title: AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.20474v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) often fail midway through unseen long-horizon tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a remedy, but embodied RSI methods either refine the harness around a frozen executor and so cannot add a missing motion, or train the executor on persistent failures without asking whether a failure lies in how the executor is called or in what it can do. We ask when a self-improving embodied system should change the weights of its executor, and propose AdaRSI, an on-demand RSI framework for embodied agents. A coding agent first improves its skills and harness, then attributes persistent failures by retrying failing sub-steps from saved states, and fine-tunes only the sub-steps that remain unreliable, with demonstrations it collects itself and experience carried over from earlier tasks. translated_title: AdaRSI：面向具身智能体的按需递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在执行未见过的长时程任务时常常中途失败。递归自我改进（RSI）提供了一种补救方法，但现有的具身RSI方法要么只是围绕冻结的执行器改进其外围框架，因而无法补充缺失的动作；要么在持续失败的情况下直接训练执行器，却不追究失败究竟源于执行器的调用方式，还是源于其自身能力。我们提出一个问题：自我改进的具身系统应当在何时改变其执行器的权重？为此我们提出了AdaRSI，一个面向具身智能体的按需RSI框架。一个编程智能体首先改进其技能和外围框架，随后通过从保存的状态重试失败的子步骤来归因持续存在的失败，并仅对仍然不可靠的子步骤进行微调，所用数据为它自行收集的示范以及从早期任务中传承的经验。在RoboCasa365的全部50个目标任务上，以GR00T N1.5作为执行器且无需任何人类示范，AdaRSI改进了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: AdaRSI提出了一种按需递归自我改进框架，先改进技能与外围框架、再通过重试归因持续失败、最后仅微调不可靠的子步骤，从而在无需人类示范的情况下显著提升具身智能体完成长时程任务的能力。
en_tdlr: AdaRSI is an on-demand recursive self-improvement framework that first refines skills and harness, then attributes persistent failures by retrying sub-steps, and fine-tunes only unreliable sub-steps, enabling embodied agents to improve on long-horizon tasks without human demonstrations.
